findings.desc: docs/requirements/decisions/source-lineage-dedup-playbook-seed-promotion-execution-plan.md:245 playbook_seed_observe still documents only the default, dev-memory, and finding-signals source paths, and lines 251-260 list reports for dev-memory/finding-signals/raw findings without naming DONE experience seeds. findings.desc: B-c28f marks CHK-001:happy:0 and CHK-002:happy:0 as CLI verification, but the smoke test covers done-experience observe/propose only through createPlaybookHandlers direct handler calls at packages/main/src/tasks/playbook-seed-promotion-loop-smoke.ts:605 and :626. The real CLI command schema still restricts --source to dev-memory|finding-signals|raw-findings|all at packages/main/src/cli/command-catalog.ts:1955 and :1960, so node packages/main/dist/cli.js playbook_seed_observe --source=done-experience --json fails validation with “Invalid option”.
